```lean
import PrisonersDilemma.Program

open PD
namespace PD.Bots

/-- MyBot defects when it can prove that doing so gets cooperation;
    otherwise it cooperates only when it can prove cooperation is reciprocated. -/
def MyBot (kDefect kCooperate : Nat) : Prog :=
  .search kDefect
    (.impl (.plays .self .opp .D) (.plays .opp .self .C))
    (.const .D)
    (.search kCooperate
      (.impl (.plays .self .opp .C) (.plays .opp .self .C))
      (.const .C)
      (.const .D))

end PD.Bots
```

```lean
import PrisonersDilemma.Program

open PD
namespace PD.Bots

/-- MyBot defects against a recognized unconditional cooperator; otherwise it cooperates when it can prove the opponent cooperates, and defects by default. -/
def MyBot (k n : Nat) : Prog :=
  .search k (.eq .opp (.const .C))
    (.const .D)
    (.search n (.plays .opp .self .C)
      (.const .C)
      (.const .D))

end PD.Bots
```
